Description: Defined format of the data file, typically corresponding to extension, but sometimes indicating more general group of files produced by the same tool or software
FASTQ file format, commonly used for storing biological sequence data, particularly from high-throughput sequencing technologies
CSV (Comma-Separated Values) file format, a widely used plain text format for representing tabular data, where each line corresponds to a row and columns are separated by commas
TXT (Text) file format, a generic plain text format that can contain unstructured or semi-structured data, often used for simple data storage or exchange
